t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes comes in pair, one leads to bright forest another to dark. Focus on the one to multiple x5 mushrooms to achieve as many mushrooms you can

vb_textbox.text: Hi game follower! There are few important things to remember!You need to be quick, as just have 1,5 seconds. Gnomes always will come in pairs: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple. Orange, green, red and blue gnomes will guide to the bright forest with red basket. The brown, pink , yellow and purple gnomes will take you the dark forest with a yellow basket.You aim to collect as many mushrooms as possible. Use the information I gave you to reach different forests to keep track of the number of mushrooms you can harvest there.You need to focus on x5 rounds as it will multiple your mushrooms.Just the colour of the gnome is matter.Good luck!
